subject: Bridge Fuel sponsorship — qualification checklist and next steps
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <hello@nimblelabs.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Foundry Accelerator <programs@foundryaccelerator.org>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry — Foundry Bridge Fuel / sponsorship for cohort 16

Hi Dylan,

Hope you're well — I'm Alex, Head of Platform at Nimble Labs (we build on top of vector search + LLMs). Foundry Accelerator runs a summer cohort and is asking if Redwood would consider a "Bridge Fuel" sponsorship for a small group of graduates: ~3 teams, short trial access and a promotional credit allocation to help them ship demos.

High-level ask: 120k token-equivalent credits to be used over 60 days, plus permission to co-list Redwood as a sponsor on the cohort site. Foundry wants confirmation this can be made available by the program start (Aug 10).

Attached is the Foundry term sheet and cohort timeline for context. Can you confirm the qualification/approval steps from Redwood's side (sales, legal, billing)? If you need a short intake form, I can fill it out.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform, Nimble Labs
[Attachment: accelerator-term-sheet.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <hello@nimblelabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry — Foundry Bridge Fuel / sponsorship for cohort 16

Alex — thanks for the note and the term sheet. Happy to explore this. A couple of quick clarifications before I loop legal / billing:

- Is the 120k token ask a firm allocation per cohort or a pooled amount across the 3 teams?
- Do teams require private deployments (VPC/on-prem) or will hosted API access be fine?
- Any compliance / customer-data concerns we should know about?

Internally, I'm adding @marissa_cole (growth partnerships) to weigh in on co-marketing and program fit, and @ben_carter (sales) to confirm commercial guardrails.

Proposed conditional offer from Redwood: milestone-based credit release (50% on activation, 50% after demo day) with a 60-day expiry and a soft usage cap to prevent runaway consumption. We usually require a brief MSA addendum for accelerator sponsorships.

If that sounds good, Ben / Marissa — can you confirm approval runway and any standard terms we should attach? Also looping @monica_patel for billing contact if we need to set a special invoice path.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Head of Growth Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry — Foundry Bridge Fuel / sponsorship for cohort 16

Dylan / Ben — I reviewed the term sheet and cohort profile. I'm supportive with the following conditions:

1) Credits: approve a total of 120k token-equivalent credits, disbursed in two tranches (60k at activation, 60k after demo day).
2) Window: 60-day usage window from activation date; any unused credits expire.
3) Usage cap: soft cap of 50k tokens per team per month; we will alert if consumption exceeds 80% of allocation.
4) Compliance: hosted API access only; no private deployment. Teams that need VPC must go through standard Dedicated evaluation.
5) Marketing: co-branding OK; marketing collateral must be pre-approved by our comms team.
6) Legal: require a short sponsorship addendum and an NDA between Nimble Labs / Foundry and Redwood; attach draft addendum.

I've attached a draft "seed-fuel" agreement that mirrors our standard accelerator sponsorship terms. Ben — please confirm whether we need an approval from Sales Ops for a zero-dollar trial with special billing flow. Monica — can you confirm the billing contact and whether we need a tracker in Salesforce for credit usage?

Attachments: seed-fuel-agreement-draft.pdf, usage-cap-proposal.xlsx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

Summary of approved terms (conditional):
- 120k token-equivalent credits total, split 60k on activation / 60k after demo day
- 60-day usage window from each team’s activation date
- Hosted API only; no private deployments for sponsored accounts
- Soft per-team cap of 50k tokens/month; we will monitor and alert at 80% consumption
- Co-marketing OK pending comms approval; Redwood logo + short blurb on cohort page
- Legal: we need a signed sponsorship addendum and an NDA; we attached a draft for your review

Action items:

2) Alex: please provide billing contact for Nimble / Foundry so Monica can provision a special tracking flow.
3) Foundry: review & sign the addendum; I'm sharing a DocuSign link once you confirm.
